name: qwen-vl-termux-screen-automation
description: Optimize screen reading and device automation using Qwen VL (Vision-Language) running in Termux, integrated with Gotcha AI. Use when automating device tasks, reading screens with minimal tokens, or combining Gotcha accessibility with a local vision model.
prerequisites: Qwen VL model available (via Ollama or llama.cpp)

setup.title: Configure Gotcha
actions: Enable accessibility service in Gotcha settings
Enable screen reading in proactive settings
Set up Termux bridge in Gotcha connectors

minimal_token_approach: Cache First: Before reading screen, check if content is cached (last 5 seconds)
Diff Detection: Only send changed regions to Qwen VL
Text Extraction: Use accessibility text first, only use vision for images/icons
Batch Processing: Group multiple screen reads into single Qwen VL call
screen_read_procedure: Send to Qwen VL with minimal prompt

caching: Cache model responses for identical queries
batching: Batch multiple elements in one call
Combine tap targets in single analysis
model_selection: Use qwen2.5vl:3b for simple tasks (faster, fewer tokens)
Use qwen2.5vl:7b only for complex reasoning
Fall back to text-only for known UI patterns

commands.query_qwen_vl: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d '{"model":"qwen2.5vl:3b","prompt":"[prompt]","images":["[base64]"],"stream":false}' | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['response'])"
screenshot_and_analysis: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d "{\"model\":\"qwen2.5vl:3b\",\"prompt\":\"[task]\",\"images\":[\"$(cat /sdcard/screenshot.b64)\"],\"stream\":false}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['response'])"

screen_reading_flow: Text content extracted via accessibility tree
If visual analysis needed -> screenshot via Termux
Screenshot sent to Qwen VL via Termux command
Result parsed and action executed via Gotcha
device_control_flow: Qwen VL analyzes screen and determines action
Gotcha executes action via accessibility service

common_issues: Ollama not running: Restart with ollama serve
Model timeout: Reduce image size or use smaller model
fallback_strategy: If vision fails, use coordinate-based heuristics
If all fail, ask user for input

performance_tips: Use JPEG instead of PNG for smaller size
Crop to relevant region instead of full screen
Cache aggressively - screens don't change that fast
Use smaller models for simple tasks
Batch actions - plan multiple steps at once
security_considerations: Never store credentials in automation scripts
Provide undo capability for destructive actions
Log all automated actions for audit
Respect app permissions and security boundaries

screen_reading_fails: Check Gotcha has screen capture permission
actions_not_executing: Verify accessibility service can perform actions
Check if target element is clickable
Ensure no system dialog is blocking
high_token_usage: Use smaller model for simple tasks
